newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper futures called to open uchanged.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper futures called to open uchanged.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open unchanged Friday as LME stocks fell and the London contract clung to gains in Thursday's rally which pushed copper futures on both sides of the Atlantic to their highest levels for almost a year.
LME stocks fell 2,400 tonnes today to 143,675 tonnes.
Just before the ring's opening, July COMEX copper traded between 116.80 an 116.00 cents a lb on ACCESS, down 0.40 cent from Thursday's close of 116.40 cents.
The LME cash to three months backwardation, which doubled on Thursday to a peak of just over $100, had eased back to about $85.
U.S. housing starts in April, forecast at 1.43 million units on an annualized basis, were due at 0830 EDT. This compares with a rate of 1.425 million units in March.
